intro: Узнайте, сколько именно воды вам следует выпивать каждый день.
howToUse: [RU] Enter your body weight into the designated input field.
[RU] Provide any secondary parameters like activity level.
[RU] Click the calculate or submit button to generate suggested ounces or liters of water.
[RU] Copy or review the resulting output for your needs.
useCases: [RU] Quickly processing body weight on the go
tipsAndLimitations: [RU] Needs increase significantly in hot weather or high altitude.
[RU] Ensure your inputs are formatted correctly for the best results.
[RU] The tool runs completely client-side, ensuring your data remains private.

faq.question: Does coffee count as water?
faq.answer: Yes, but plain water is the best source of hydration.

faq.question: Is the Water Intake Calculator free to use?
faq.answer: Yes, our Water Intake Calculator is completely free and requires no registration.

faq.question: Does this work on mobile devices?
faq.answer: Yes, the tool is fully responsive and functions perfectly on all smartphones and tablets.
